Accessories are arranged at the top-right and bottom-right corners with gentle rotations (10° and 5° respectively) and progressively smaller sizes (32% and 28% width).

Z-index layering creates depth hierarchy: main item (z:1), primary accessory (z:2), shoes (z:3), and secondary accessory (z:4).    240→ * @returns Number of entries actually evicted
   241→ */
   242→function evictOldestCacheEntries(count: number = 1): number {
   243→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 0
   244→
   245→  try {
   246→    // Collect all flat-lay cache entries with their timestamps
   247→    const cacheEntries: Array<{ key: string; timestamp: number }> = []
   248→
   249→    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
   250→      const key = localStorage.key(i)
   251→      if (key?.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX)) {
   252→        try {
   253→          const cached = localStorage.getItem(key)
   254→          if (cached) {
   255→            const parsed: CachedImage = JSON.parse(cached)
   256→            cacheEntries.push({ key, timestamp: parsed.timestamp })
   257→          }
   258→        } catch {
   259→          // Corrupted entry, add with timestamp 0 to prioritize removal
   260→          cacheEntries.push({ key, timestamp: 0 })
   261→        }
   262→      }
   263→    }
   264→
   265→    if (cacheEntries.length === 0) {
   266→      return 0
   267→    }
   268→
   269→    // Sort by timestamp (oldest first)
   270→    cacheEntries.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp)
   271→
   272→    // Remove the specified number of oldest entries
   273→    const toEvict = Math.min(count, cacheEntries.length)
   274→    let evicted = 0
   275→
   276→    for (let i = 0; i < toEvict; i++) {
   277→      try {
   278→        localStorage.removeItem(cacheEntries[i].key)
   279→        evicted++
   280→      } catch {
   281→        // Failed to remove, continue with others
   282→        console.warn(`[useFlatLayGeneration] Failed to evict cache entry: ${cacheEntries[i].key}`)
   283→      }
   284→    }
   285→
   286→    return evicted
   287→  } catch (error) {
   288→    console.warn('[useFlatLayGeneration] Error during cache eviction:', error)
   289→    return 0
   290→  }
   291→}

   371→/**
   372→ * Custom hook for lazy flat-lay image generation with caching
   373→ *
   374→ * Features:
   375→ * - Checks localStorage cache synchronously on initial render
   376→ * - Supports lazy loading via Intersection Observer

   381→export function useFlatLayGeneration({
   382→  outfitId,
   383→  items,
   384→  occasionContext,
   385→}: UseFlatLayGenerationOptions): UseFlatLayGenerationResult {

   387→  const [flatLayImageBase64, setFlatLayImageBase64] = useState<string | undefined>(() => {
   388→    const cached = getCachedImage(outfitId)
   389→    return cached || undefined
   390→  })
   391→  const [isFromCache, setIsFromCache] = useState<boolean>(() => {
   392→    return !!getCachedImage(outfitId)
   393→  })
   394→  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false)
   395→  const [isQueued, setIsQueued] = useState(false)
   396→  const [queuePosition, setQueuePosition] = useState(0)
   397→  const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined)
   398→
   399→  // Track if generation has been attempted for this outfit
   400→  const hasAttemptedRef = useRef(false)
   401→  // Track if component is mounted
   402→  const isMountedRef = useRef(true)
   403→  // Track the current outfitId for cleanup
   404→  const currentOutfitIdRef = useRef(outfitId)
   405→
   406→  // Reset state when outfitId changes
   407→  useEffect(() => {
   408→    if (currentOutfitIdRef.current !== outfitId) {
   409→      // Remove old request from queue if exists
   410→      removeFromQueue(currentOutfitIdRef.current)
   411→
   412→      // Check new outfit's cache
   413→      const cached = getCachedImage(outfitId)
   414→      if (cached) {
   415→        setFlatLayImageBase64(cached)
   416→        setIsFromCache(true)
   417→        hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   418→      } else {
   419→        setFlatLayImageBase64(undefined)
   420→        setIsFromCache(false)
   421→        hasAttemptedRef.current = false
   422→      }
   423→
   424→      setIsGenerating(false)
   425→      setIsQueued(false)
   426→      setQueuePosition(0)
   427→      setError(undefined)
   428→      currentOutfitIdRef.current = outfitId
   429→    }
   430→  }, [outfitId])
   431→
   432→  // Update queue position periodically when queued
   433→  useEffect(() => {
   434→    if (!isQueued) return
   435→
   436→    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   437→      const pos = getQueuePosition(outfitId)
   438→      if (isMountedRef.current) {
   439→        setQueuePosition(pos)
   440→        if (pos === 0) {
   441→          // No longer in queue, stop checking
   442→          setIsQueued(false)
   443→        }
   444→      }
   445→    }, 500)
   446→
   447→    return () => clearInterval(interval)
   448→  }, [isQueued, outfitId])
   449→
   450→  // Cleanup on unmount
   451→  useEffect(() => {
   452→    isMountedRef.current = true
   453→    return () => {
   454→      isMountedRef.current = false
   455→      // Remove from queue on unmount
   456→      removeFromQueue(outfitId)
   457→    }
   458→  }, [outfitId])
   459→
   460→  /**
   461→   * Internal function to perform the actual generation
   462→   */
   463→  const performGeneration = useCallback(async () => {
   464→    if (!isMountedRef.current) return
   465→
   466→    // Mark as generating, not queued
   467→    setIsQueued(false)
   468→    setQueuePosition(0)
   469→    setIsGenerating(true)
   470→    setError(undefined)
   471→    hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   472→    currentGenerations++
   473→
   474→    // Transform products to flat-lay items with visual consistency validation
   475→    const transformResult = transformToFlatLayItems(items)
   476→
   477→    // Log visual consistency warnings
   478→    if (transformResult.hasInconsistentItems) {
   479→      console.warn(
   480→        '[useFlatLayGeneration] Visual consistency issues detected in outfit items. ' +
   481→        'Flat-lay image may not match product thumbnails.',
   482→        transformResult.validationIssues
   483→      )
   484→    }
   485→
   486→    // Extract just the items for the API call
   487→    const flatLayItems = transformResult.items
   488→
   489→    // Retry logic with exponential backoff
   490→    const maxRetries = 1
   491→    let lastError: string | undefined
   492→
   493→    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
   494→      try {
   495→        if (attempt > 0) {
   496→          // Exponential backoff: 2^attempt * 1000ms
   497→          const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000
   498→          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay))
   499→        }
   500→
   501→        const response = await fetch('/api/generate-image', {
   502→          method: 'POST',
   503→          headers: {
   504→            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   505→          },
   506→          body: JSON.stringify({
   507→            generationType: 'flat-lay',
   508→            flatLayItems,
   509→            occasionContext,
   510→          }),
   511→        })
   512→
   513→        const result: ImageGenerationResponse = await response.json()
   514→
   515→        if (!isMountedRef.current) {
   516→          currentGenerations--
   517→          processQueue() // Allow next in queue to proceed
   518→          return
   519→        }
   520→
   521→        if (result.success && result.imageBase64) {
   522→          setFlatLayImageBase64(result.imageBase64)
   523→          setIsFromCache(false)
   524→          setError(undefined)
   525→          // Cache the generated image
   526→          setCachedImage(outfitId, result.imageBase64)
   527→          currentGenerations--
   528→          setIsGenerating(false)
   529→          processQueue() // Process next in queue
   530→          return
   531→        } else {
   532→          lastError = result.message || result.error || 'Generation failed'
   533→        }
   534→      } catch (err) {
   535→        console.error('[useFlatLayGeneration] API error:', err)
   536→        lastError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Network error'
   537→      }
   538→    }
   539→
   540→    // All retries failed
   541→    if (isMountedRef.current) {
   542→      setError(lastError)
   543→      setIsGenerating(false)
   544→    }
   545→    currentGenerations--
   546→    processQueue() // Process next in queue even on failure
   547→  }, [outfitId, items, occasionContext])
   548→
   549→  /**
   550→   * Generate flat-lay image via API
   551→   * Uses global queue for concurrency management
   552→   */
   553→  const generateFlatLay = useCallback(() => {
   554→    // Skip if already attempted, generating, queued, or has image
   555→    if (hasAttemptedRef.current || isGenerating || isQueued || flatLayImageBase64) {
   556→      return
   557→    }
   558→
   559→    // Check cache again in case it was populated while not observing
   560→    const cached = getCachedImage(outfitId)
   561→    if (cached) {
   562→      setFlatLayImageBase64(cached)
   563→      setIsFromCache(true)
   564→      hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   565→      return
   566→    }
   567→
   568→    // Check concurrent generation limit
   569→    if (currentGenerations >= MAX_CONCURRENT_GENERATIONS) {
   570→      // Add to queue
   571→      const queuedRequest: QueuedRequest = {
   572→        id: outfitId,
   573→        execute: performGeneration,
   574→      }
   575→      generationQueue.push(queuedRequest)
   576→      setIsQueued(true)
   577→      setQueuePosition(generationQueue.length)
   578→      return
   579→    }
   580→
   581→    // Slot available, generate immediately
   582→    performGeneration()
   583→  }, [outfitId, isGenerating, isQueued, flatLayImageBase64, performGeneration])
   584→
   585→  return {
   586→    isGenerating,
   587→    isQueued,
   588→    queuePosition,
   589→    flatLayImageBase64,
   590→    error,
   591→    generateFlatLay,
   592→    isFromCache,
   593→  }
   594→}

   596→/**
   597→ * Hook for using Intersection Observer to trigger lazy generation
   598→ */
   599→export function useIntersectionObserver(
   600→  callback: () => void,
   601→  options?: IntersectionObserverInit
   602→): React.RefCallback<HTMLElement> {
   603→  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null)
   604→  const hasTriggeredRef = useRef(false)
   605→
   606→  const setRef = useCallback(
   607→    (element: HTMLElement | null) => {
   608→      // Disconnect previous observer
   609→      if (observerRef.current) {
   610→        observerRef.current.disconnect()
   611→        observerRef.current = null
   612→      }
   613→
   614→      // Skip if already triggered or no element
   615→      if (hasTriggeredRef.current || !element) {
   616→        return
   617→      }
   618→
   619→      observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   620→        (entries) => {
   621→          const [entry] = entries
   622→          if (entry?.isIntersecting && !hasTriggeredRef.current) {
   623→            hasTriggeredRef.current = true
   624→            callback()
   625→            // Disconnect after triggering
   626→            observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   627→          }
   628→        },
   629→        {
   630→          threshold: 0.1, // Trigger when 10% visible
   631→          ...options,
   632→        }
   633→      )
   634→
   635→      observerRef.current.observe(element)
   636→    },
   637→    [callback, options]
   638→  )
   639→
   640→  // Cleanup on unmount
   641→  useEffect(() => {
   642→    return () => {
   643→      observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   644→    }
   645→  }, [])
   646→
   647→  return setRef
   648→}

# OOTDay - AI Fashion Assistant

An AI-powered fashion assistant platform that helps users with daily outfit decisions and connects fashion inspiration directly to purchase opportunities.

## Overview

OOTDay combines:
- **AI Chat Interface**: Natural language fashion recommendations powered by Claude AI
- **Product Matching**: Integration with Central Group inventory for direct purchases
- **Multi-Agent Development**: Automated task processing with parallel Claude Code agents

## Quick Start

### Frontend Development

```bash
cd apps/web
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to view the app.

### Environment Setup

```bash
cp .env.sample .env
# Add your API keys:
# - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude AI
# - Other integrations as needed
```

## Project Structure

```
/
├── apps/
│   ├── web/                    # Next.js frontend application
│   └── sentiment_classification/ # ML sentiment classifier
├── docs/
│   ├── prd/                    # Product requirements
│   ├── architecture/           # System architecture
│   └── guides/                 # Development guides
├── scripts/
│   └── adws/                   # AI Dev Workflows (automation)
├── data/
│   ├── products/               # Product data (JSON)
│   ├── personas/               # AI persona definitions
│   ├── catalogs/               # Product catalogs (CSV)

├── specs/                      # Feature specifications
├── tasks/                      # Task definitions
├── archive/                    # Archived content
├── .claude/                    # Claude Code configuration
└── tasks.md                    # Central task tracking
```

## Multi-Agent Task System

The repository includes an automated multi-agent system for development tasks:

### Task Format (tasks.md)

```markdown
## Git Worktree feature-name
[] Pending task
[🟡, adw_12345] In progress
[✅ abc123, adw_12345] Completed
[❌, adw_12345] Failed // reason
[⏰] Blocked (waiting for dependencies)
```

### Running the Automation

```bash
# Trigger task processing
./scripts/adws/adw_triggers/adw_trigger_cron_todone.py

# Individual workflows
./scripts/adws/adw_build_update_task.py
./scripts/adws/adw_plan_implement_update_task.py
```

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 with TypeScript

- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4
- **Testing**: Playwright for E2E tests

### Development Tools
- **AI Assistant**: Claude Code with custom skills

1→/**
     2→ * Product Visual Validator
     3→ *
     4→ * Validates visual consistency between product data (name, description)
     5→ * and product images (imageUrl, thumbnailUrl) to prevent mismatches
     6→ * in flat-lay image generation and product list display.
     7→ *
     8→ * The primary issue: AI-generated flat-lay images may show feminine items
     9→ * based on text descriptions, but the product thumbnails from the catalog
    10→ * may show masculine items (e.g., "Formal Heels" but oxford shoe thumbnail).
    11→ *
    12→ * This validator detects such inconsistencies and provides strategies
    13→ * for handling them.
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import type { Product } from '../types'
    17→
    18→/**
    19→ * Visual gender category for product classification
    20→ */
    21→export type VisualGenderCategory = 'masculine' | 'feminine' | 'neutral'
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Result of visual consistency validation
    25→ */
    26→export interface ProductVisualConsistency {
    27→  /** Whether the product's visual elements are consistent */
    28→  isConsistent: boolean
    29→  /** List of detected issues */
    30→  issues: string[]
    31→  /** Inferred gender category from product text */
    32→  textGender: VisualGenderCategory
    33→  /** Inferred gender category from image URL patterns */
    34→  imageGender: VisualGenderCategory
    35→  /** Confidence score (0-1) for the assessment */
    36→  confidence: number
    37→}
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Configuration for visual validation
    41→ */
    42→export interface VisualValidationConfig {
    43→  /** Whether to log validation results to console */
    44→  enableLogging?: boolean
    45→  /** Strictness level for validation (higher = more strict) */
    46→  strictnessLevel?: 1 | 2 | 3
    47→}
    48→
    49→// Default configuration
    50→const DEFAULT_CONFIG: VisualValidationConfig = {
    51→  enableLogging: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development',
    52→  strictnessLevel: 2,
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Masculine footwear patterns in image URLs
    57→ */
    58→const MASCULINE_IMAGE_PATTERNS = [
    59→  /\/oxford/i,
    60→  /\/derby/i,
    61→  /\/brogue/i,
    62→  /\/wingtip/i,
    63→  /\/men[_-]?shoe/i,
    64→  /\/men[_-]?dress/i,
    65→  /\/men[_-]?loafer/i,
    66→  /\/men[_-]?boot/i,
    67→  /\/monk[_-]?strap/i,
    68→  /\/cap[_-]?toe/i,
    69→  /\/dress[_-]?shoe[_-]?m/i, // dress-shoe-m for men
    70→  /_m_/i, // common pattern for men's items
    71→  /-m-/i,
    72→  /[_-]mens?[_-]/i,
    73→]
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Feminine footwear patterns in image URLs
    77→ */
    78→const FEMININE_IMAGE_PATTERNS = [
    79→  /\/heel/i,
    80→  /\/pump/i,
    81→  /\/stiletto/i,
    82→  /\/mule/i,
    83→  /\/slingback/i,
    84→  /\/ballet/i,
    85→  /\/flat[_-]?shoe/i,
    86→  /\/women[_-]?shoe/i,
    87→  /\/women[_-]?sandal/i,
    88→  /\/women[_-]?boot/i,
    89→  /\/women[_-]?loafer/i,
    90→  /\/womens[_-]?loafer/i, // handle "womens-loafer" pattern
    91→  /\/pointed[_-]?toe/i,
    92→  /\/kitten[_-]?heel/i,
    93→  /\/block[_-]?heel/i,
    94→  /\/wedge/i,
    95→  /\/espadrille/i,
    96→  /[_-]womens?[_-]/i,
    97→  /womens-/i, // handle "womens-" prefix
    98→  /_w_/i, // common pattern for women's items
    99→  /-w-/i,
   100→]
   101→
   102→/**
   103→ * Masculine keywords in product text (name, description)
   104→ */
   105→const MASCULINE_TEXT_KEYWORDS = [
   106→  'oxford shoe',
   107→  'derby shoe',
   108→  'brogue',
   109→  'wingtip',
   110→  "men's shoe",
   111→  'mens shoe',
   112→  "men's loafer",
   113→  "men's oxford",
   114→  "men's derby",
   115→  "men's boot",
   116→  'monk strap',
   117→  'cap toe dress',
   118→  'formal men',
   119→]
   120→
   121→/**
   122→ * Feminine keywords in product text (name, description)
   123→ */
   124→const FEMININE_TEXT_KEYWORDS = [
   125→  'heel',
   126→  'pump',
   127→  'stiletto',
   128→  'mule',
   129→  'slingback',
   130→  'ballet flat',
   131→  "women's shoe",
   132→  'womens shoe',
   133→  "women's loafer",
   134→  "women's sandal",
   135→  "women's boot",
   136→  'pointed toe',
   137→  'kitten heel',
   138→  'block heel',
   139→  'wedge',
   140→  'espadrille',
   141→  'ankle boot',
   142→  'knee boot',
   143→  'peep toe',
   144→]
   145→
   146→/**
   147→ * Detect visual gender category from image URL patterns
   148→ */
   149→export function getImageGenderCategory(imageUrl: string | undefined): VisualGenderCategory {
   150→  if (!imageUrl) return 'neutral'
   151→
   152→  const url = imageUrl.toLowerCase()
   153→
   154→  // Check for masculine patterns
   155→  const hasMasculinePattern = MASCULINE_IMAGE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(url))
   156→
   157→  // Check for feminine patterns
   158→  const hasFemininePattern = FEMININE_IMAGE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(url))
   159→
   160→  if (hasMasculinePattern && !hasFemininePattern) return 'masculine'
   161→  if (hasFemininePattern && !hasMasculinePattern) return 'feminine'
   162→  if (hasMasculinePattern && hasFemininePattern) return 'neutral' // Conflicting signals
   163→
   164→  return 'neutral'
   165→}
   166→
   167→/**
   168→ * Detect visual gender category from product text (name, description)
   169→ */
   170→export function getTextGenderCategory(product: Product): VisualGenderCategory {
   171→  const combined = `${product.name || ''} ${product.visualDescription || ''} ${product.subCategory || ''}`.toLowerCase()
   172→
   173→  // Check for masculine keywords
   174→  const hasMasculineText = MASCULINE_TEXT_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => combined.includes(keyword))
   175→
   176→  // Check for feminine keywords
   177→  const hasFeminineText = FEMININE_TEXT_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => combined.includes(keyword))
   178→
   179→  if (hasMasculineText && !hasFeminineText) return 'masculine'
   180→  if (hasFeminineText && !hasMasculineText) return 'feminine'
   181→  if (hasMasculineText && hasFeminineText) return 'neutral' // Conflicting signals
   182→
   183→  return 'neutral'
   184→}
   185→
   186→/**
   187→ * Get overall visual gender category for a product
   188→ * Combines text and image analysis
   189→ */
   190→export function getProductVisualCategory(product: Product): VisualGenderCategory {
   191→  const textGender = getTextGenderCategory(product)
   192→  const imageGender = getImageGenderCategory(product.imageUrl)
   193→
   194→  // If both agree, use that
   195→  if (textGender === imageGender) return textGender
   196→
   197→  // If one is neutral, use the other
   198→  if (textGender === 'neutral') return imageGender
   199→  if (imageGender === 'neutral') return textGender
   200→
   201→  // If they conflict, prioritize text (product name is more reliable than URL patterns)
   202→  // But flag this as potentially inconsistent
   203→  return textGender
   204→}
   205→
   206→/**
   207→ * Validate visual consistency between product text and product image
   208→ *
   209→ * Returns detailed information about any mismatches detected
   210→ */
   211→export function validateProductVisualConsistency(
   212→  product: Product,
   213→  config: VisualValidationConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   214→): ProductVisualConsistency {
   215→  const textGender = getTextGenderCategory(product)
   216→  const imageGender = getImageGenderCategory(product.imageUrl)
   217→
   218→  const issues: string[] = []
   219→  let confidence = 1.0
   220→
   221→  // Check for gender mismatch
   222→  if (textGender !== 'neutral' && imageGender !== 'neutral' && textGender !== imageGender) {
   223→    issues.push(
   224→      `Gender mismatch: text suggests "${textGender}" but image URL suggests "${imageGender}"`
   225→    )
   226→    confidence = 0.3
   227→  }
   228→
   229→  // Check for specific problematic patterns
   230→  const name = (product.name || '').toLowerCase()
   231→  const imageUrl = (product.imageUrl || '').toLowerCase()
   232→
   233→  // "Heels" in name but oxford/derby in image URL
   234→  if (name.includes('heel') && (imageUrl.includes('oxford') || imageUrl.includes('derby') || imageUrl.includes('brogue'))) {
   235→    issues.push('Product named "heels" but image URL contains masculine shoe pattern')
   236→    confidence = 0.1
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // "Formal Heels" but men's shoe in image URL
   240→  if (name.includes('formal') && name.includes('heel') && MASCULINE_IMAGE_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(imageUrl))) {
   241→    issues.push('Formal heels product with masculine shoe image URL')
   242→    confidence = 0.1
   243→  }
   244→
   245→  // Women's product with masculine image patterns
   246→  if ((product.category?.toLowerCase().includes('women') || textGender === 'feminine') && imageGender === 'masculine') {
   247→    issues.push('Women\'s product category but image URL suggests masculine product')
   248→    confidence = 0.2
   249→  }
   250→
   251→  const isConsistent = issues.length === 0
   252→
   253→  // Log if enabled
   254→  if (config.enableLogging && !isConsistent) {
   255→    console.warn(
   256→      `[VisualValidator] Product ${product.sku}: INCONSISTENT - ${issues.join('; ')}`
   257→    )
   258→  } else if (config.enableLogging && config.strictnessLevel === 3) {
   259→    console.debug(
   260→      `[VisualValidator] Product ${product.sku}: CONSISTENT (text: ${textGender}, image: ${imageGender})`
   261→    )
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  return {
   265→    isConsistent,
   266→    issues,
   267→    textGender,
   268→    imageGender,
   269→    confidence,
   270→  }
   271→}
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Check if a product is suitable for inclusion in a women's outfit
   275→ * considering visual consistency
   276→ */
   277→export function isVisuallyConsistentForWomen(
   278→  product: Product,
   279→  config: VisualValidationConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   280→): boolean {
   281→  const validation = validateProductVisualConsistency(product, config)
   282→
   283→  // Reject if there are gender mismatches and image suggests masculine
   284→  if (!validation.isConsistent && validation.imageGender === 'masculine') {
   285→    return false
   286→  }
   287→
   288→  // Reject if explicitly masculine
   289→  if (validation.textGender === 'masculine' || validation.imageGender === 'masculine') {
   290→    return false
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  return true
   294→}
   295→
   296→/**
   297→ * Filter products to only include those with consistent visuals for women's outfits
   298→ */
   299→export function filterVisuallyConsistentProducts(
   300→  products: Product[],
   301→  targetGender: 'women' | 'men' = 'women',
   302→  config: VisualValidationConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   303→): Product[] {
   304→  return products.filter((product) => {
   305→    const validation = validateProductVisualConsistency(product, config)
   306→
   307→    if (targetGender === 'women') {
   308→      return isVisuallyConsistentForWomen(product, config)
   309→    } else {
   310→      // For men's products, reject if feminine
   311→      return validation.textGender !== 'feminine' && validation.imageGender !== 'feminine'
   312→    }
   313→  })
   314→}
   315→
   316→/**
   317→ * Get a summary of visual consistency issues for a set of products
   318→ * Useful for debugging and data quality reporting
   319→ */
   320→export function getVisualConsistencySummary(
   321→  products: Product[],
   322→  config: VisualValidationConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   323→): {
   324→  total: number
   325→  consistent: number
   326→  inconsistent: number
   327→  issues: Array<{ sku: string; name: string; issues: string[] }>
   328→} {
   329→  const results = products.map((product) => ({
   330→    product,
   331→    validation: validateProductVisualConsistency(product, { ...config, enableLogging: false }),
   332→  }))
   333→
   334→  const consistent = results.filter((r) => r.validation.isConsistent).length
   335→  const inconsistent = results.filter((r) => !r.validation.isConsistent)
   336→
   337→  return {
   338→    total: products.length,
   339→    consistent,
   340→    inconsistent: inconsistent.length,
   341→    issues: inconsistent.map((r) => ({
   342→      sku: r.product.sku,
   343→      name: r.product.name,
   344→      issues: r.validation.issues,
   345→    })),
   346→  }
   347→}
   348→
   349→/**
   350→ * Validate that a product's thumbnail will match the flat-lay image description
   351→ *
   352→ * This is the key function for preventing the mismatch issue:
   353→ * - If the product text describes feminine footwear (heels, pumps)
   354→ * - But the product thumbnail shows masculine footwear (oxfords, derbies)
   355→ * - The flat-lay will show heels but the product list will show oxfords
   356→ */
   357→export function validateFlatLayThumbnailMatch(
   358→  product: Product,
   359→  config: VisualValidationConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   360→): {
   361→  matches: boolean
   362→  reason?: string
   363→  recommendation?: 'include' | 'exclude' | 'replace' | 'use-text-only'
   364→} {
   365→  const validation = validateProductVisualConsistency(product, config)
   366→
   367→  if (validation.isConsistent) {
   368→    return { matches: true, recommendation: 'include' }
   369→  }
   370→
   371→  // Specific case: feminine text but masculine image (the main bug scenario)
   372→  if (validation.textGender === 'feminine' && validation.imageGender === 'masculine') {
   373→    return {
   374→      matches: false,
   375→      reason: `Product "${product.name}" has feminine description but masculine image`,
   376→      recommendation: 'exclude', // Prefer finding a replacement
   377→    }
   378→  }
   379→
   380→  // Specific case: masculine text but feminine image (less common)
   381→  if (validation.textGender === 'masculine' && validation.imageGender === 'feminine') {
   382→    return {
   383→      matches: false,
   384→      reason: `Product "${product.name}" has masculine description but feminine image`,
   385→      recommendation: 'exclude',
   386→    }
   387→  }
   388→
   389→  // Unknown mismatch
   390→  return {
   391→    matches: false,
   392→    reason: validation.issues.join('; '),
   393→    recommendation: 'use-text-only', // Fall back to text description in flat-lay
   394→  }
   395→}
